title: Atlas meeting import contract v1 — frontmatter
description: The YAML frontmatter of a meeting file, read as JSON. The body's rules (sections, transcript turns, block ids) are in meeting-import-v1.md; Atlas's validator checks both. Keys not named here are allowed: Atlas adds its own (atlas_import_error, atlas_duplicate_of).

date.description: The day, quoted. A day the calendar has: no 30 February.

kind.description: What the provider or the mapping called it: Standup, Retro, 1:1…

provider.description: Who wrote the notes up: gemini, granola, or the next one.

external_id.description: The provider's own id for the meeting, quoted: a second file with the same provider and external_id is a duplicate.

transcript_clock.description: What the transcript's times count. Default elapsed.

group.description: true for a group address (platform-team@…): kept, never made a Person.
